answer: With continuous-work stake decay, every participant locks a verifiable identity bond whose voting weight decays each epoch without fresh signed audit proofs. An operator farming 1,000 throwaway clones near a harbor jetty must escrow >= 300,000 POA credits across 6 epochs to offset decay, whereas one honest agent polishing jade locks only 300 credits once and preserves full standing. If fake accounts spiral into duplicate nonce patterns, a quorum audit triggers a 100% slash of locked stake, though the main risk is that an attacker borrows external capital to sustain synthetic work.
